scope: Sourced production marks and one real italic parameter font. No new direction or generated assets.

sources.publisher: The Tomorrow Project Authors; distributed by Google Fonts

assets.use: White wordmark for both blurred templates.
Black wordmark when a black mark is needed on a light ground.
Complete yellow Nikon symbol in the white information-strip template.
Sidebar F / ISO / S labels and parameter values. Actual italic face: no synthetic skew or fake bold.
Font copyright and license to accompany redistribution.

transformations.nikon-wordmark-white.png: Isolate final authentic Nikon vector path without contour changes; change fill #150301 to #FFFFFF. CairoSVG render at 4000 square; trim alpha bounds; proportional Pillow Lanczos resize to 1600 pixels wide. Transparent background.
transformations.nikon-wordmark-black.png: Same authentic vector path and geometry as white version; use #000000 fill. Transparent background.
transformations.nikon-yellow-square.png: Complete official SVG rendered unchanged at 1024 square with CairoSVG.

font_fidelity.selected: Tomorrow ExtraBold Italic, genuine weight 800 italic display font.
font_fidelity.matches: Heavy squared sports-style silhouette, slanted strokes, angular counters, and compact block-like F / ISO / S / numeric forms.
font_fidelity.differences: Original reference font is unidentified. Tomorrow has pronounced chamfered corners and different 2, 3, 8 and slash outlines; it is a close practical stylistic match, not an exact face match.
font_fidelity.comparison: Compared actual Tomorrow Bold/ExtraBold/Black Italic, Chakra Petch Bold Italic, and Quantico Bold Italic samples. ExtraBold has the closest reviewed stroke weight.

references.use: Visual comparison only; no pixels copied into production assets.
Visual comparison only; no pixels copied into production assets.

production_methods.raster_processing: Pillow for proportional resizing and alpha bounds only
